name: The Way You Should Dress
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God in their outward appearance by avoiding practices such as marking the body or adopting clothing that blurs distinct gender roles, as these are described as abominations to the LORD. True beauty and favor are found not in external adornment but in a reverent fear of the LORD, which brings genuine praise. Faith, rooted in hearing and embracing God's Word, shapes how believers live, including how they present themselves in dress.
